clean_story:
Now I will teach you Earth. It is the big, round ground under your feet, stretching far beyond what you see. It has high rocks, deep waters, and wide flat lands where beasts walk. The sun warms it by day, the dark sky covers it by night. You stand on it, but it is much bigger than all caves and forests you know. It holds all tribes, all beasts, all waters in its belly. This is Earth.

Discover stone, water, sky.
